name: Peanuts by Schulz
description: Remember the legendary comic strip, celebrated all over the world? Now, watch it come to life on screen! Peanuts brings to you the vintage charm and timeless stories of Charlie Brown's gang with a renewed zest. Join in the adventurous world of the wildly imaginative, supremely confident and world-famous beagle, Snoopy.
